newsitem.title: UK: Euro vgo touch softer, buying fair, supplies good.
newsitem.headline: Euro vgo touch softer, buying fair, supplies good.

text.p: European vacuum gas oil was easier on Wednesday from last week's levels although activity was deemed to be fair.
Two barges were sold on Tuesday: a 1.6 percent parcel going for $157 fob and a 2.3 percent package selling at $155.
Traders said supplies of high sulphur material was good, and at least one major buyer was going to take a back seat until mid December.
Low sulphur avails were deemed to be tighter although still sufficient to absorb muted demand.
U.S. interest remains, but traders said it was unlikely to draw away fast quantities. "It's not as bullish as some people had thought," said one.
